email.body1:
Shari, saw Juno Health was picked as the statewide public health EHR vendor for the Tennessee Department of Health.

A win at that scale usually means more in-market health systems than the team can cover before the momentum cools, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Juno Health off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Juno Health needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
